seeded_flaws.description: Goal says 'improve user satisfaction' but has no baseline, target, or timeframe.
None of the requirements have a priority marker (P0, P1, etc.).
The requirement 'Add a toggle in Settings' has no acceptance criteria attached.
The requirement 'Ensure the app is fast when switching themes' is weak (no observable threshold for 'fast').
Scope lists what is in, but the only exclusions are in the non-goals. No explicit boundary of the feature.
Contradiction between Scope ('changes to dark colors' - implies multiple/arbitrary colors) and Requirements ('a dark mode theme' - implies a standardized, singular palette).
